gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Audio Science Review's Amir measured the $599 Denon PMA-600NE (14 Nov 2023) and declined to recommend it: its distortion 'can't even clear the noise floor of CD (-93 to -96 dB)' and its DAC landed in his 'poor' group. Amir found the $399 WiiM Amp Pro 'in every way improved' (26 Sep 2024), and the SoundStage! Lab measured the Marantz Model 50 at 83 W/8 Ω and 132 W/4 Ω at 1% THD+N, above Marantz's 70/100 W rating.
standout_why: I compared against recordplayeradvice.com (Denon vs Yamaha), hifiaudiosource.com (Yamaha vs Denon), stylusandsound.com/best-stereo-amplifiers and whathifi.com/best-buys (the body was truncated, so no product list was readable). Recordplayeradvice gives no lab measurements and names no tester. Hifiaudiosource says every figure comes from the maker's product pages and that the author does not own either amp. Stylus and Sound says 'We did not test these products by hand' and cites no ASR or SoundStage data. None of the four has a named third-party measurement for the Denon, the WiiM Amp Pro or the Marantz Model 50.
decides: This argues against the Denon PMA-600NE, ChatGPT's $599 'Bluetooth and turntable' pick: the only named bench test of it ends in 'can't recommend', and it costs more than the Yamaha and the WiiM. It supports the $399 WiiM Amp Pro for streaming, since ASR praised its noise and found its response unchanged between 4 Ω and 8 Ω loads. It also confirms the $2,000 Marantz Model 50 beats its own power and damping specs (SoundStage! Lab, APx555). The Yamaha A-S301 has no English-language bench test I could open, so its standing rests on Yamaha's specs and What Hi-Fi's listening review.

findings.label: ASR verdict (Amir, audiosciencereview.com)
findings.value: Not recommended: 'I can't get excited over this level of performance so can't recommend Denon PMA-600NE'
findings.source_title: Denon PMA-600NE Integrated Amplifier Review (Audio Science Review)
findings.note: Posted 2023-11-14. Measured on the CD input with Source Direct, volume set for 29 dB gain. Amir also wrote 'For the cost, I think you are getting what you paid for but no more.' The sample was on loan from a member, priced at US $499 then.

findings.label: ASR distortion vs CD noise floor
findings.value: Distortion too high to clear the CD noise floor of -93 to -96 dB
findings.source_title: Denon PMA-600NE Integrated Amplifier Review (Audio Science Review)
findings.note: Verbatim: 'Shame we have high enough distortion that we can't even clear the noise floor of CD (-93 to -96 dB).' Also: 'Noise performance at 5 watts is not great but gets better at full power.' The exact SINAD figure appears only in chart images, which I could not read.

findings.label: ASR measured gain and power
findings.value: 35 dB fixed gain in Source Direct; more than the rated 45 W/8 Ω and 70 W/4 Ω at 1% THD
findings.source_title: Denon PMA-600NE Integrated Amplifier Review (Audio Science Review)
findings.note: Verbatim: 'Allowing 1% THD and testing for continuous vs burst gives us more than specified power which is good.' The exact wattages are in chart images only, so no number is given here.

findings.label: ASR verdict and power (Amir)
findings.value: 117 W measured; 'in every way improved over the original version'
findings.source_title: WiiM Amp Pro Streaming Stereo Amplifier Review (Audio Science Review)
findings.note: Posted 2024-09-26. Verbatim: '117 watts is plenty though for where this amp will get deployed'. In context this is the 4 Ω result against WiiM's 120 W/4 Ω rating, but the text I could read does not state the load. Output is limited to avoid clipping. Amir called noise performance 'excellent' and said frequency response 'shows essentially no difference with the two load impedances' (PFFB). SINAD is in chart images only.

findings.label: SoundStage! Lab power at 1% THD+N
findings.value: 83 W/8 Ω (rated 70 W); 132 W/4 Ω (rated 100 W)
findings.source_title: Marantz Model 50 Integrated Amplifier: Measurements (SoundStage! Lab)
findings.note: Measured by Diego Estan on an Audio Precision APx555 B, published 2024-05-01. No-load clipping voltage was 30.4 Vrms. In the continuous dynamic test it held 145 W/4 Ω (about 3.5% THD) for 233 of 500 s before fault protection engaged. It was stable into 2 Ω.

findings.label: SoundStage! Lab THD, SNR, damping
findings.value: THD below 0.005% at 10 W/8 Ω; SNR 108.5 dB A-weighted at 70 W (rated 116 dB); damping factor 190 (rated 100)
findings.source_title: Marantz Model 50 Integrated Amplifier: Measurements (SoundStage! Lab)
findings.note: SNR was measured with 2 Vrms in and falls to 88.4 dB at maximum volume. Frequency response was -0.1 dB at 5 Hz and -0.2 dB at 100 kHz.

findings.label: SoundStage! Lab phono stage
findings.value: MM phono SNR 87.5 dB A-weighted at 70 W; RIAA deviation about +0.25/-0.1 dB
findings.source_title: Marantz Model 50 Integrated Amplifier: Measurements (SoundStage! Lab)
findings.note: Measured with 5 mVrms in. SNR falls to 76.6 dB at maximum volume.
